description: This Kotlin source file defines the LocalTaskStore class, which manages local storage of Task objects using Android shared preferences. It provides methods for loading, saving, adding, updating, deleting, and marking tasks as completed, utilizing JSON for serialization.

classes.name: LocalTaskStore
classes.description: Manages local persistent storage of Task objects, providing CRUD operations and serialization/deserialization via JSON.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and decodes the list of tasks from shared preferences.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes the list of tasks to JSON and saves to shared preferences.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Converts a list of Task objects to a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to a list of Task objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task with given title and description, assigns a unique ID, and updates storage.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task's details based on the provided ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a task by its ID.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Marks a task as completed or not based on the provided boolean.
